the retry decision, driven on any host via a platform shim

edit.description: claudeCode's spawn retry reads the shared predicate; its streaming retry stays local

summary: Share the win32 .cmd-shim spawn retry across execGate, execInstall and claudeCode — one detection, one home

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

pins: a win32 ENOENT from the direct spawn retries once through the shell
a non-ENOENT win32 spawn failure propagates without a shell retry
an ENOENT on a non-win32 host propagates without a shell retry
shellGate retries a win32 ENOENT through the shell when the host is not win32
acceptance: One exported shim predicate/wrapper; the three spawn sites read it rather than respell it; the retry decision runs on every host, not only under describe.runIf(win32).
notes: Three verbatim spellings of `platform === win32 && code === ENOENT` → retry with shell: src/builtinGates.ts:48, src/setupWorktree.ts:40, src/Agent.ts:224. execGate's retry is exercised only by tests/Gate.test.ts:151's describe.runIf(win32), which runs in none of this repo's runs; setupWorktree's identical copy is exercised on any host. src/fsProbe.ts is the precedent for the leaf home.

edit.description: §3's `Fanout only` extraEnv bullet and the `for fanout` scoping around it

summary: Retire the fanout-only scoping of setupWorktree in docs/CHAIN-AUTHORING.md §3 and src/setupWorktree.ts's header — singletons provision too
acceptance: No prose in docs/ or src/ scopes setupWorktree or extraEnv to fanout; the extraEnv scope note states what runSingleton does.
notes: docs/CHAIN-AUTHORING.md:807 states `Singleton phases never invoke setupWorktree, so they never carry extraEnv`. src/Dispatcher.ts:1840 invokes it from runSingleton and consumes extraEnv; tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:674 pins that green; docs/MIGRATING-0.12.md:29 announced the change. The spec sentence the docs contradict is the `Both concurrencies carry the hooks and extraEnv` clause.
